releaseNotes:
Rookline 0.6.27 installs independently for telemetry, session analysis, setup support, and optional AI coaching. RookForce is a separate optional application with its own installation, interface, and lifetime. Rookline remains usable when RookForce is absent or unavailable.

The Windows installers are not Authenticode-signed. Rookline verifies the published Rookline installer with the SHA-256 value in the HTTPS release manifest before updater launch.
